newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria April fx reserves double to $1,145.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria April fx reserves double to $1,145.6 mln.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank said in a statement on Monday its foreign exchange reserves doubled in April to $1,145.5 million from $554.3 million in March.

The BNB said that $398.927 million were held in current accounts and short-term deposits in foreign banks and $607.366 million were held in foreign securities and International Monetary Fund reserve position.
The statement said $97.726 million were held in precious metals deposited with first class foreign correspondent banks and $41.599 million were held in deposits in local commercial banks.
Bulgaria's monetary gold reserves held in the vaults of the central bank stood at 32.074 tonnes, or about 1.03 million troy ounces on April 30, said the BNB.
The rise was mainly due to BNB net dollar purchases and $178.7 million of International Monetary Fund (IMF) loans received under a funding package approved in April, a BNB official said.
A further $160 million came from the sell off of 60 percent in soda ash producer Sodi to Belgian chemicals and drugs group Solvay SA.
BNB FX RESERVES APRIL 30 MARCH APRIL'96
